fixed.summary: A plant's thinned leaf levels now draw the full mesh's own vertices, each kept leaf enlarged about its anchor by the level's leaf scale, instead of storing enlarged copies. The built-in pine, oak and willow kinds now cook within the default budgets.vertices of 65,536 (pine 95,697 to 63,297, oak 86,045 to 54,020, willow 76,343 to 50,828), and every leafy plant needs about a third less vertex memory. Triangles, levels, their errors and the drawn crowns are unchanged.
